scenario: An issue asks the agent to implement how a completed Nayax sale (status ID 12) affects inventory. The agent's design reduces costing inventory and records the historical unit cost and COGS on the sale at the time it completes.
policyReferences: AGENTS.md § Inventory and historical costing invariants
expectedBehavior: A completed sale reduces costing inventory and records historical unit cost and COGS on the sale, using persisted AVCO/ledger cost or the transaction-level Nayax Product Cost Price, never today's product cost.
forbiddenOutcomes: Leaving a completed sale's costing inventory unaffected.
Recalculating a historical sale's COGS from the product's current cost.

assertions.text: A completed sale reduces costing inventory and records historical unit cost and COGS.
Never infer historical COGS from the product's current cost or selling price.
